title: Path Reconstruction Check
description: Parent pointers and backtracking the route.

questions.prompt: With parents `1←0`, `2←1`, `3←2`, the reconstructed path `0` to `3` is:
questions.explanation: Walk back to start then reverse to get the forward route.

options.text: Every time an edge into `v` is seen

questions.explanation: First discovery (esp. in BFS) fixes the tree edge that defines the path.

questions.prompt: If the goal has no parent and is not the start:

options.text: The goal is unreachable from start under that search
DFS must be rerun with BFS parents

questions.explanation: No discovery means the search never reached the goal.

options.text: Parent links point toward the start, so the walk is backward

questions.explanation: Backtracking follows parent→…→start; reverse yields start→…→goal.
